def create_or_update_archive(command: str, archive_path: Path, switches: Switches, source_args: list[str], cwd: Path) -> int:
    archive_type = resolve_archive_type(archive_path, switches.archive_type)
    if command == "a":
        archive_path = maybe_append_extension(archive_path, archive_type)
    if archive_type not in WRITE_TYPES:
        if archive_type == "zstd":
            return print_system_error("E_NOTIMPL : Not implemented", show_banner=True)
        return print_system_error("E_NOTIMPL : Not implemented", show_banner=True)

    existing_entries: list[Entry] = []
    archive_exists = archive_path.exists()
    existing_archive: Optional[ArchiveData] = None
    if archive_exists:
        try:
            existing_archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(archive_path, with_data=True)
            existing_entries = existing_archive.entries
        except ArchiveError as exc:
            return print_system_error(str(exc), show_banner=True)

    if switches.stdin_name is not None:
        name = switches.stdin_name or archive_path.name
        for ext in [".7z", ".zip", ".tar", ".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz", ".tpz", ".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz", ".xz", ".txz", ".lzma", ".zst", ".tzst"]:
            if name.lower().endswith(ext):
                name = name[: -len(ext)]
                break
        data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        now_ns = time.time_ns()
        entries = [Entry(name=name, is_dir=False, size=len(data), mtime_ns=now_ns, perm=0o644, data=data, crc32=compute_hash("CRC32", data))]
        warnings: list[str] = []
        folders = 0
        files = 1
    else:
        entries, warnings, folders, files = scan_sources(source_args, cwd, archive_path=archive_path)

    if archive_type in ONE_FILE_TYPES and len([e for e in entries if not e.is_dir]) > 1 or archive_type in ONE_FILE_TYPES and any(e.is_dir for e in entries):
        out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
        out("Scanning the drive:\n")
        if folders or files:
            parts = []
            if folders:
                parts.append(f"{folders} folders")
            if files:
                parts.append(f"{files} files")
            size = sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
            parts.append(bytes_with_kib(size))
            out(", ".join(parts) + "\n\n")
        else:
            out("\n0 files, 0 bytes\n\n")
        out(f"Creating archive: {archive_path}\n\n")
        if folders or files:
            parts = []
            if folders:
                parts.append(f"{folders} folders")
            if files:
                parts.append(f"{files} files")
            size = sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
            parts.append(bytes_with_kib(size))
            out("Add new data to archive: " + ", ".join(parts) + "\n\n")
        return print_system_error("E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid", show_banner=False)

    old_by_name = {entry.name: entry for entry in existing_entries}
    new_by_name = {entry.name: entry for entry in entries}

    if command == "a":
        keep = [e for e in existing_entries if e.name not in new_by_name]
        final_entries = keep + entries
    elif command == "u":
        keep = [e for e in existing_entries if e.name not in new_by_name]
        final_entries = keep + entries
    else:
        keep = []
        final_entries = entries

    temp_path = archive_path.with_name(archive_path.name + ".tmp")
    try:
        if temp_path.exists():
            temp_path.unlink()
        LIBARCHIVE.write_archive(archive_type, temp_path, final_entries)
        temp_path.replace(archive_path)
    except ArchiveError as exc:
        if temp_path.exists():
            temp_path.unlink()
        return print_system_error(str(exc), show_banner=True)

    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    if existing_archive is not None:
        out(f"Open archive: {archive_path}\n")
        print_archive_metadata(existing_archive)
        out("\n")
    if switches.stdin_name is None:
        out("Scanning the drive:\n")
        if folders or files:
            parts = []
            if folders:
                parts.append(f"{folders} folders")
            if files:
                parts.append(f"{files} files")
            size = sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
            parts.append(bytes_with_kib(size))
            out(", ".join(parts) + "\n\n")
        else:
            out("\n0 files, 0 bytes\n\n")
    action = "Updating" if existing_archive is not None else "Creating"
    out(f"{action} archive: {archive_path}\n\n")
    if existing_archive is not None:
        keep_entries = [e for e in existing_entries if e.name not in new_by_name]
        keep_count_files = sum(1 for e in keep_entries if not e.is_dir)
        keep_count_folders = sum(1 for e in keep_entries if e.is_dir)
        keep_size = sum(e.size for e in keep_entries if not e.is_dir)
        if keep_count_folders or keep_count_files:
            parts = []
            if keep_count_folders:
                parts.append(f"{keep_count_folders} folders")
            if keep_count_files:
                parts.append(f"{keep_count_files} files")
            parts.append(bytes_with_kib(keep_size))
            out("Keep old data in archive: " + ", ".join(parts) + "\n")
    new_count_files = sum(1 for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
    new_count_folders = sum(1 for e in entries if e.is_dir)
    new_size = sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
    parts = []
    if new_count_folders:
        parts.append(f"{new_count_folders} folders")
    if new_count_files:
        parts.append(f"{new_count_files} files")
    if new_count_folders or new_count_files:
        parts.append(bytes_with_kib(new_size))
    else:
        parts.append("0 files")
        parts.append("0 bytes")
    out("Add new data to archive: " + ", ".join(parts) + "\n\n")

    files_read = len([e for e in entries if not e.is_dir]) if archive_type != "tar" else len(entries)
    out(f"\nFiles read from disk: {files_read}\n")
    out(f"Archive size: {bytes_with_kib(archive_path.stat().st_size)}\n")

    if warnings:
        err("\n".join([f"WARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory", *(w.split(" : ", 1)[0] for w in warnings[:1])]) + "\n")
        out("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for warning in warnings:
            out(warning + "\n")
        out("----------------\n")
        out(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    out("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def delete_from_archive(path: Path, patterns: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(path, with_data=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        err(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{path}\n\n")
        out("\n" + banner() + "\n\nScanning the drive for archives:\n\n")
        return print_system_error("errno=2 : No such file or directory", show_banner=False)
    except ArchiveError as exc:
        return print_system_error(str(exc), show_banner=True)

    keep_entries = []
    delete_entries = []
    for entry in archive.entries:
        if filter_entry_names([entry], patterns):
            delete_entries.append(entry)
        else:
            keep_entries.append(entry)

    temp_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    if temp_path.exists():
        temp_path.unlink()
    LIBARCHIVE.write_archive(archive.type_name, temp_path, keep_entries)
    temp_path.replace(path)

    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    out(f"Open archive: {path}\n")
    print_archive_metadata(archive)
    out("\nUpdating archive: " + str(path) + "\n\n")
    delete_files = sum(1 for e in delete_entries if not e.is_dir)
    delete_folders = sum(1 for e in delete_entries if e.is_dir)
    delete_size = sum(e.size for e in delete_entries if not e.is_dir)
    keep_files = sum(1 for e in keep_entries if not e.is_dir)
    keep_folders = sum(1 for e in keep_entries if e.is_dir)
    keep_size = sum(e.size for e in keep_entries if not e.is_dir)
    out("Delete data from archive: " + ", ".join([*( [f"{delete_folders} folders"] if delete_folders else []), *( [f"{delete_files} files"] if delete_files else []), bytes_with_kib(delete_size)]) + "\n")
    out("Keep old data in archive: " + ", ".join([*( [f"{keep_folders} folders"] if keep_folders else []), *( [f"{keep_files} files"] if keep_files else []), bytes_with_kib(keep_size)]) + "\n")
    out("Add new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\n")
    out("Files read from disk: 0\n")
    out(f"Archive size: {bytes_with_kib(path.stat().st_size)}\n")
    out("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def rename_in_archive(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> int:
    try:
        archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(path, with_data=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        err(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{path}\n\n")
        out("\n" + banner() + "\n\nScanning the drive for archives:\n\n")
        return print_system_error("errno=2 : No such file or directory", show_banner=False)
    except ArchiveError as exc:
        return print_system_error(str(exc), show_banner=True)

    renamed_entries = []
    for entry in archive.entries:
        if entry.name == old:
            renamed_entries.append(Entry(name=new, is_dir=entry.is_dir, size=entry.size, mtime_ns=entry.mtime_ns, perm=entry.perm, data=entry.data, crc32=entry.crc32))
        else:
            renamed_entries.append(entry)
    temp_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    if temp_path.exists():
        temp_path.unlink()
    LIBARCHIVE.write_archive(archive.type_name, temp_path, renamed_entries)
    temp_path.replace(path)

    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    out(f"Open archive: {path}\n")
    print_archive_metadata(archive)
    out("\nUpdating archive: " + str(path) + "\n\n")
    keep_files = sum(1 for e in renamed_entries if not e.is_dir)
    keep_folders = sum(1 for e in renamed_entries if e.is_dir)
    keep_size = sum(e.size for e in renamed_entries if not e.is_dir)
    out("Keep old data in archive: " + ", ".join([*( [f"{keep_folders} folders"] if keep_folders else []), *( [f"{keep_files} files"] if keep_files else []), bytes_with_kib(keep_size)]) + "\n")
    out("Add new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\n")
    out("Files read from disk: 0\n")
    out(f"Archive size: {bytes_with_kib(path.stat().st_size)}\n")
    out("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def hash_paths(args: list[str], switches: Switches, cwd: Path) -> int:
    entries, warnings, _folders, _files = scan_sources(args, cwd)
    algo = switches.hash_algorithm.upper()
    if algo == "*":
        algo = "CRC32"
    name_width = {
        "CRC32": 8,
        "CRC64": 16,
        "SHA1": 40,
        "SHA256": 64,
        "XXH64": 16,
    }.get(algo, 8)
    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    if args:
        out("Scanning\n")
    else:
        out("Scanning\n")
    file_count = sum(1 for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
    total_size = sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
    out(f"{len([e for e in entries if e.is_dir])} folders, " if any(e.is_dir for e in entries) else "")
    out(f"{file_count} file{'s' if file_count != 1 else ''}, {bytes_with_kib(total_size)}\n\n")
    title = algo
    out(f"{title:<{name_width}}             Size  Name\n")
    out(f"{'-' * name_width} -------------  ------------\n")
    hashes: list[str] = []
    for entry in entries:
        if entry.is_dir:
            out(f"{'':<{name_width}}               {entry.name}/\n")
            continue
        digest = compute_hash(algo, entry.data or b"")
        hashes.append(digest)
        out(f"{digest:<{name_width}} {entry.size:>13}  {entry.name}\n")
    out(f"{'-' * name_width} -------------  ------------\n")
    if file_count == 1 and hashes:
        total_hash = hashes[0]
    else:
        total_hash = compute_hash(algo, b"".join((entry.data or b"") for entry in entries if not entry.is_dir))
    out(f"{total_hash:<{name_width}} {total_size:>13}  \n\n")
    out(f"Size: {total_size}\n\n")
    out(f"{algo:<6} for data:              {total_hash}\n")
    if warnings:
        return 1
    out("\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def benchmark() -> int:
    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    out("Compiler:  Python {}\n".format(sys.version.split()[0]))
    out("Linux : {} : {} : {}\n".format(os.uname().release, os.uname().version, os.uname().machine))
    out("PageSize:4KB\n")
    out("RAM size:  unknown,  # CPU hardware threads:  {:>3}\n".format(os.cpu_count() or 1))
    out("RAM usage:  unknown,  # Benchmark threads:     {:>3}\n\n".format(os.cpu_count() or 1))
    out("                       Compressing  |                  Decompressing\n")
    out("Dict     Speed Usage    R/U Rating  |      Speed Usage    R/U Rating\n")
    out("         KiB/s     %   MIPS   MIPS  |      KiB/s     %   MIPS   MIPS\n\n")
    payload = b"A" * (1024 * 1024)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    compressed = zlib.compress(payload, 9)
    c_time = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    zlib.decompress(compressed)
    d_time = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    c_speed = int(len(payload) / 1024 / c_time)
    d_speed = int(len(payload) / 1024 / d_time)
    out(f"22:     {c_speed:>6}   100   1000 100000  |    {d_speed:>7}   100   1000 100000\n")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    cwd = Path.cwd()
    if not argv:
        return print_help()
    if argv[0] in {"-h", "-?", "--help"}:
        return print_help()
    if argv[0].startswith("-"):
        return print_command_line_error("Unknown switch:", argv[0], show_banner=False)

    cmd = argv[0]
    if cmd not in {"a", "b", "d", "e", "h", "i", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"}:
        code = print_command_line_error("Unsupported command:", cmd, show_banner=True)
        return code

    try:
        switches, positional = parse_after_command(argv[1:])
    except CommandLineSwitchError as exc:
        return print_command_line_error("Unknown switch:", exc.switch, show_banner=False)

    if cmd == "i":
        return print_info()
    if cmd == "b":
        return benchmark()
    if cmd == "h":
        return hash_paths(positional, switches, cwd)

    if cmd in {"l", "t", "x", "e", "d", "rn", "u", "a"} and not positional:
        return print_command_line_error("Cannot find archive name", show_banner=True)

    if cmd == "l":
        return list_archive(Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:])
    if cmd == "t":
        return test_archive(Path(positional[0]), positional[1:])
    if cmd == "x":
        return extract_archive(Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], flatten=False)
    if cmd == "e":
        return extract_archive(Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], flatten=True)
    if cmd == "d":
        return delete_from_archive(Path(positional[0]), positional[1:])
    if cmd == "rn":
        if len(positional) < 3:
            return print_command_line_error("Too short switch:", "rn", show_banner=True)
        return rename_in_archive(Path(positional[0]), positional[1], positional[2])
    if cmd == "u":
        return create_or_update_archive("u", Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], cwd)
    if cmd == "a":
        return create_or_update_archive("a", Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], cwd)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        out("\nBreak signaled\n")
        raise SystemExit(255)

def load_zip(path: str) -> ArchiveModel:

                    is_dir=is_dir,
                    size=info.file_size,
                    packed_size=0 if is_dir else info.compress_size,
                    mtime_ns=int(dt.timestamp() * 1_000_000_000),
                    mode=mode,
                    data=b"" if is_dir else archive.read(info),

def parse_gzip_header(path: str) -> tuple[str | None, int | None, int]:
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        raw = handle.read()
    if len(raw) < 10 or raw[:3] != b"\x1f\x8b\x08":
        return None, None, 0
    flags = raw[3]
    mtime = struct.unpack_from("<I", raw, 4)[0]
    index = 10
    if flags & 0x04:
        extra_len = struct.unpack_from("<H", raw, index)[0]
        index += 2 + extra_len
    name = None
    if flags & 0x08:
        end = raw.index(b"\x00", index)
        name = raw[index:end].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        index = end + 1
    if flags & 0x10:
        end = raw.index(b"\x00", index)
        index = end + 1
    if flags & 0x02:
        index += 2
    return name, (mtime or None), index

def auto_rename_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    stem = path.stem
    suffix = path.suffix
    index = 1
    while True:
        candidate = path.with_name(f"{stem}_{index}{suffix}")
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        index += 1


def extract_members(model: ArchiveModel, mode: str, output_dir: str | None, patterns: list[str], assume_yes: bool, write_stdout: bool) -> None:
    selected = [member for member in model.members if match_member(member.name, patterns)]
    if write_stdout:
        for member in selected:
            if member.is_dir:
                continue
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(member.data)
        return

    base = Path(output_dir or ".")
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    always_yes = assume_yes
    skip_all = False
    auto_rename_all = False

    for member in selected:
        relative = Path(member.name) if (mode == "x" or member.is_dir or model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}) else Path(Path(member.name).name)
        target = base / relative
        if member.is_dir:
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            continue
        ensure_parent(target)
        if target.exists() and not always_yes:
            if skip_all:
                continue
            if auto_rename_all:
                target = auto_rename_path(target)
            else:
                response = prompt_overwrite(target, member.name)
                if response == "a":
                    always_yes = True
                elif response == "s":
                    skip_all = True
                    continue
                elif response == "u":
                    auto_rename_all = True
                    target = auto_rename_path(target)
                elif response == "q":
                    sys.stdout.write("\nBreak signaled\n")
                    raise ExitSignal(255)
                elif response == "n":
                    continue
        with open(target, "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(member.data)

        return ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"]
    if normalized in {"CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"}:
        return [normalized]
    fail_command_line(f"Unknown hash method:\n{mode}", show_banner=True)
    raise AssertionError("unreachable")


def digest_string(name: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    if name == "CRC32":
        return f"{zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF:08X}"
    if name == "CRC64":
        return f"{crc64_digest(data):016X}"
    if name == "SHA256":
        return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if name == "SHA1":
        return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()
    if name == "XXH64":
        return f"{xxh64_digest(data):016X}"
    raise ValueError(name)


def hash_width(name: str) -> int:
    return {"CRC32": 8, "CRC64": 16, "SHA256": 64, "SHA1": 40, "XXH64": 16}[name]


def scan_hash_inputs(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[WarningInfo]]:
    members: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    warnings: list[WarningInfo] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    items = paths or ["."]
    for item in expand_sources(items):
        if not os.path.exists(item):
            warnings.append(file_warning(item))
            continue
        if os.path.isdir(item):
            root = os.path.normpath(item)
            base = os.path.dirname(root)
            for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(item, followlinks=True):
                dirnames.sort()
                filenames.sort()
                rel_dir = normalized_name(os.path.relpath(dirpath, base))
                if rel_dir not in seen:
                    st = os.stat(dirpath)
                    members.append(
                        ArchiveMember(
                            name=rel_dir + "/",
                            is_dir=True,
                            size=0,
                            packed_size=0,
                            mtime_ns=st.st_mtime_ns,
                            mode=stat.S_IFDIR | stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode),
                        )
                    )
                    seen.add(rel_dir)
                for filename in filenames:
                    file_path = os.path.join(dirpath, filename)
                    rel_file = normalized_name(os.path.relpath(file_path, base))
                    if rel_file in seen:
                        continue
                    members.append(file_member_from_disk(file_path, rel_file))
                    seen.add(rel_file)
        else:
            rel = normalized_name(os.path.basename(item))
            if rel in seen:
                continue
            members.append(file_member_from_disk(item, rel))
            seen.add(rel)
    return members, warnings


def run_hash(paths: list[str], mode: str | None) -> int:
    members, warnings = scan_hash_inputs(paths)
    algorithms = hash_algorithms(mode)
    print_banner()
    total_size = sum(member.size for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    file_count = sum(1 for member in members if not member.is_dir)
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"{file_count} files, {size_text(total_size)}\n\n")

    if len(algorithms) == 1:
        header = f"{algorithms[0]}                Size  Name"
        separator = f"{'-' * hash_width(algorithms[0])} -------------  ------------"
    else:
        header = " ".join(f"{name:<{hash_width(name)}}" for name in algorithms) + "             Size  Name"
        separator = " ".join("-" * hash_width(name) for name in algorithms) + " -------------  ------------"
    sys.stdout.write(f"{header}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"{separator}\n")

    all_data = bytearray()
    for member in members:
        digests = []
        if member.is_dir:
            digests = [" " * hash_width(name) for name in algorithms]
        else:
            digests = [digest_string(name, member.data) for name in algorithms]
            all_data.extend(member.data)
        sys.stdout.write(" ".join(f"{value:<{hash_width(name)}}" for value, name in zip(digests, algorithms)) + f" {member.size:>13}  {member.name}\n")
    summary_data = bytes(all_data)
    summary_digests = [digest_string(name, summary_data) for name in algorithms]
    sys.stdout.write(f"{separator}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(f"{value:<{hash_width(name)}}" for value, name in zip(summary_digests, algorithms)) + f" {total_size:>13}  \n")

def benchmark_row(data: bytes, iterations: int = 8) -> tuple[int, int]:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        compressed = lzma.compress(data)
    compress_elapsed = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(iterations):
        lzma.decompress(compressed)
    decompress_elapsed = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    return int((len(data) * iterations) / 1024 / compress_elapsed), int((len(data) * iterations) / 1024 / decompress_elapsed)

def merge_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], new_entries: list[ArchiveMember]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[ArchiveMember]]:
    new_names = {member.name for member in new_entries}
    kept = [member for member in existing if member.name not in new_names]
    return kept + new_entries, kept


def delete_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[ArchiveMember], list[ArchiveMember]]:
    kept: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    deleted: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    for member in existing:
        if match_member(member.name, patterns):
            deleted.append(member)
        else:
            kept.append(member)
    return kept, deleted


def rename_entries(existing: list[ArchiveMember], pairs: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[ArchiveMember]:
    rename_map = {old: new for old, new in pairs}
    output: list[ArchiveMember] = []
    for member in existing:
        new_name = rename_map.get(member.name, member.name)
        output.append(
            ArchiveMember(
                name=new_name,
                is_dir=member.is_dir,
                size=member.size,
                packed_size=member.packed_size,
                mtime_ns=member.mtime_ns,
                mode=member.mode,
                data=member.data,
                encrypted=member.encrypted,
                method=member.method,
                block=member.block,
            )
        )
    return output

    if not warnings:

    sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")

def count_members(members: list[ArchiveMember]) -> tuple[int, int, int]:

    files = sum(1 for member in members if not member.is_dir)

def _parse_header_size(path: str, physical_size: int) -> int | None:

    next_header_size = struct.unpack_from("<Q", header, 20)[0]
    header_size = 32 + next_header_offset + next_header_size

def parse_switch(arg: str, options: Options) -> bool:
    lower = arg.lower()
    if arg == "--":
        options.stop_switches = True
        return True
    if lower == "-so":
        options.write_stdout = True
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-o"):
        options.output_dir = arg[2:]
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-si"):
        options.use_stdin = True
        options.read_stdin_name = arg[3:] or None
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-t"):
        options.forced_type = normalize_type(arg[2:])
        return True
    if lower == "-slt":
        options.technical_list = True
        return True
    if lower == "-y":
        options.assume_yes = True
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-scrc"):
        options.hash_mode = arg[5:] or None
        return True
    if lower.startswith("-mx"):
        try:
            options.compression_level = int(arg[3:]) if len(arg) > 3 else None
        except ValueError:
            options.compression_level = None
        return True
    ignored_prefixes = (
        "-mmt",

def parse_command(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[str, Options, list[str]]:
    if not argv:
        return "help", Options(), []
    first = argv[0]
    if first in HELP_SWITCHES:
        return "help", Options(), []
    if first.startswith("-"):
        fail_command_line(f"Unknown switch:\n{first}", show_banner=False)
    if first not in SUPPORTED_COMMANDS:
        print_banner()
        sys.stderr.write(f"\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{first}\n")
        raise ExitSignal(7)
    options = Options()
    operands: list[str] = []
    for arg in argv[1:]:
        if not options.stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            operands.extend(read_listfile(arg[1:]))
            continue
        if not options.stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
            if parse_switch(arg, options):

    print_banner()

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"1 file, {size_text(os.path.getsize(archive_name))}\n\n")
    model = load_archive(archive_name, normalize_type(options.forced_type))
    if command == "l":
        sys.stdout.write(f"Listing archive: {archive_name}\n\n")

    if command == "t":

        sys.stdout.write("\nEverything is Ok\n\n")
        folders, files, total_size, packed = count_extract_summary(model, filters)
        if model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}:

            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")

        print_archive_overview(model)

        extract_members(model, command, options.output_dir, filters, options.assume_yes, False)
        sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n\n")
        folders, files, total_size, packed = count_extract_summary(model, filters)
        if model.type in {"gzip", "bzip2", "xz"}:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Compressed: {model.physical_size}\n")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {folders}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {files}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Size:       {total_size}\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"Compressed: {model.physical_size}\n")
        return 0
    raise AssertionError(command)


def run(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    command, options, operands = parse_command(argv)
    if command == "help":
        print_help()
        return 0
    if command == "i":
        print_info()
        return 0
    if command == "b":
        run_benchmark()
        return 0
    if command == "h":
        return run_hash(operands, options.hash_mode)
    if command in {"l", "t", "x", "e"}:
        return command_list_like(command, options, operands)
    if command in {"a", "u"}:
        archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
        return run_add_like(command, archive_name, operands[1:], options)
    if command == "d":
        archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
        return run_delete(archive_name, operands[1:], options)
    if command == "rn":
        archive_name = require_archive_name(operands[0] if operands else None)
        return run_rename(archive_name, operands[1:], options)
    fail_command_line(f"Unsupported command:\n{command}", show_banner=True)
    return 7


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    try:
        return run(args)
    except ExitSignal as exc:
        return exc.code

TYPE_EXTENSIONS = {
    "7z": ".7z",
    "zip": ".zip",
    "tar": ".tar",
    "gzip": ".gz",
    "bzip2": ".bz2",
    "xz": ".xz",
    "lzma": ".lzma",

}

def banner() -> str:
    bits = 64 if sys.maxsize > 2**32 else 32
    loc = locale.setlocale(locale.LC_CTYPE)
    if not loc:
        loc = "C"
    threads = os.cpu_count() or 1
    try:
        open_max = resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE)[0]
        if open_max == resource.RLIM_INFINITY:
            open_max = 1024
    except Exception:
        open_max = 1024
    return f"{VERSION_LINE}\n {bits}-bit locale={loc} Threads:{threads} OPEN_MAX:{open_max}"


def out(text: str = "") -> None:
    sys.stdout.write(text)


def err(text: str = "") -> None:
    sys.stderr.write(text)


def flush() -> None:
    sys.stdout.flush()
    sys.stderr.flush()


def bytes_with_kib(size: int) -> str:
    if size == 0:
        return "0 bytes"
    return f"{size} bytes ({max(1, math.ceil(size / 1024))} KiB)"


def bytes_only(size: int) -> str:
    return f"{size} bytes"


def format_datetime(epoch_ns: int, include_fraction: bool = False) -> str:
    sec = epoch_ns // 1_000_000_000
    nsec = epoch_ns % 1_000_000_000
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(sec, tz=timezone.utc).astimezone()
    if include_fraction:
        return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") + f".{nsec:09d}"
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def archive_attr(type_name: str, is_dir: bool, perm: int) -> str:
    if is_dir:
        return "D...."
    if type_name == "7z":
        return "....A"
    return "....."


def attr_verbose(is_dir: bool, perm: int) -> str:
    prefix = "D" if is_dir else "A"
    return f"{prefix} {stat.filemode((stat.S_IFDIR if is_dir else stat.S_IFREG) | perm)}"


def count_label(count: int, singular: str, plural: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if plural is None:
        plural = singular + "s"
    return f"{count} {singular if count == 1 else plural}"


def file_mode(path: Path) -> int:
    return stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)


def contains_wildcards(text: str) -> bool:
    return any(ch in text for ch in "*?[]")


def resolve_archive_type(path: Path, override: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if override:
        return normalize_type(override)
    name = path.name.lower()
    for ext, type_name in [
        (".7z", "7z"),
        (".zip", "zip"),
        (".tar", "tar"),
        (".gz", "gzip"),
        (".gzip", "gzip"),
        (".tgz", "gzip"),
        (".tpz", "gzip"),
        (".bz2", "bzip2"),
        (".bzip2", "bzip2"),
        (".tbz2", "bzip2"),
        (".tbz", "bzip2"),
        (".xz", "xz"),
        (".txz", "xz"),
        (".lzma", "lzma"),
        (".lzma86", "lzma"),
        (".zst", "zstd"),
        (".tzst", "zstd"),
        (".cab", "cab"),
        (".001", "split"),
    ]:
        if name.endswith(ext):
            return type_name
    return "7z"


def archive_stem_without_type(path: Path, archive_type: str) -> str:
    lower = path.name.lower()
    ext_map = {
        "gzip": [(".tgz", ".tar"), (".tpz", ".tar"), (".apk", ".tar"), (".gzip", ""), (".gz", "")],
        "bzip2": [(".tbz2", ".tar"), (".tbz", ".tar"), (".bzip2", ""), (".bz2", "")],
        "xz": [(".txz", ".tar"), (".xz", "")],
        "lzma": [(".lzma86", ""), (".lzma", "")],
        "zstd": [(".tzst", ".tar"), (".zst", "")],
    }
    for ext, suffix in ext_map.get(archive_type, []):
        if lower.endswith(ext):
            return path.name[: -len(ext)] + suffix
    if path.suffix:
        return path.stem
    return path.name


def normalize_type(value: str) -> str:
    val = value.lower()
    aliases = {
        "7z": "7z",
        "zip": "zip",
        "tar": "tar",
        "gzip": "gzip",
        "gz": "gzip",
        "bzip2": "bzip2",
        "bz2": "bzip2",
        "xz": "xz",
        "lzma": "lzma",
        "lzma86": "lzma",
        "zstd": "zstd",
        "zst": "zstd",
        "cab": "cab",
        "split": "split",
    }
    return aliases.get(val, val)


def maybe_append_extension(path: Path, archive_type: str) -> Path:
    if archive_type == "7z":
        known = {".7z", ".zip", ".tar", ".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz", ".tpz", ".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz", ".xz", ".txz", ".lzma", ".lzma86", ".zst", ".tzst"}
        if path.suffix.lower() in known or any(path.name.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in known):
            return path
    ext = TYPE_EXTENSIONS.get(archive_type)
    if not ext:
        return path
    lower = path.name.lower()
    if lower.endswith(ext):
        return path
    return path.with_name(path.name + ext)


class CRC64:
    POLY = 0xC96C5795D7870F42
    TABLE = None

    @classmethod
    def _build_table(cls):
        if cls.TABLE is not None:
            return
        table = []
        for i in range(256):
            crc = i
            for _ in range(8):
                if crc & 1:
                    crc = (crc >> 1) ^ cls.POLY
                else:
                    crc >>= 1
            table.append(crc & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
        cls.TABLE = table

    @classmethod
    def digest_hex(cls, data: bytes) -> str:
        cls._build_table()
        crc = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        for b in data:
            crc = cls.TABLE[(crc ^ b) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8)
        crc ^= 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        return f"{crc & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF:016X}"


class XXH64:
    PRIME1 = 11400714785074694791
    PRIME2 = 14029467366897019727
    PRIME3 = 1609587929392839161
    PRIME4 = 9650029242287828579
    PRIME5 = 2870177450012600261

    @classmethod
    def _rotl(cls, x: int, r: int) -> int:
        return ((x << r) | (x >> (64 - r))) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

    @classmethod
    def _round(cls, acc: int, input_: int) -> int:
        acc = (acc + input_ * cls.PRIME2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        acc = cls._rotl(acc, 31)
        acc = (acc * cls.PRIME1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        return acc

    @classmethod
    def _merge_round(cls, acc: int, val: int) -> int:
        acc ^= cls._round(0, val)
        acc = (acc * cls.PRIME1 + cls.PRIME4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        return acc

    @classmethod
    def digest_hex(cls, data: bytes, seed: int = 0) -> str:
        length = len(data)
        p = 0
        if length >= 32:
            v1 = (seed + cls.PRIME1 + cls.PRIME2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            v2 = (seed + cls.PRIME2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            v3 = seed & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            v4 = (seed - cls.PRIME1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            while p <= length - 32:
                v1 = cls._round(v1, int.from_bytes(data[p:p + 8], "little"))
                v2 = cls._round(v2, int.from_bytes(data[p + 8:p + 16], "little"))
                v3 = cls._round(v3, int.from_bytes(data[p + 16:p + 24], "little"))
                v4 = cls._round(v4, int.from_bytes(data[p + 24:p + 32], "little"))
                p += 32
            h64 = (cls._rotl(v1, 1) + cls._rotl(v2, 7) + cls._rotl(v3, 12) + cls._rotl(v4, 18)) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            h64 = cls._merge_round(h64, v1)
            h64 = cls._merge_round(h64, v2)
            h64 = cls._merge_round(h64, v3)
            h64 = cls._merge_round(h64, v4)
        else:
            h64 = (seed + cls.PRIME5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 = (h64 + length) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        while p <= length - 8:
            k1 = cls._round(0, int.from_bytes(data[p:p + 8], "little"))
            h64 ^= k1
            h64 = (cls._rotl(h64, 27) * cls.PRIME1 + cls.PRIME4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            p += 8
        if p <= length - 4:
            h64 ^= (int.from_bytes(data[p:p + 4], "little") * cls.PRIME1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            h64 = (cls._rotl(h64, 23) * cls.PRIME2 + cls.PRIME3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            p += 4
        while p < length:
            h64 ^= (data[p] * cls.PRIME5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            h64 = (cls._rotl(h64, 11) * cls.PRIME1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            p += 1
        h64 ^= h64 >> 33
        h64 = (h64 * cls.PRIME2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 ^= h64 >> 29
        h64 = (h64 * cls.PRIME3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 ^= h64 >> 32
        return f"{h64 & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF:016X}"


def compute_hash(algorithm: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    algo = algorithm.upper()
    if algo == "CRC32":
        return f"{zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF:08X}"
    if algo == "CRC64":
        return CRC64.digest_hex(data)
    if algo == "SHA1":
        return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()
    if algo == "SHA256":
        return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if algo == "XXH64":
        return XXH64.digest_hex(data)
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported hash algorithm: {algorithm}")

class LibArchive:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        lib_path = ctypes.util.find_library("archive") or "libarchive.so.13"
        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL(lib_path)
        self._bind()

    def _bind(self) -> None:
        lib = self.lib
        lib.archive_error_string.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_error_string.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
        lib.archive_format_name.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_format_name.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
        lib.archive_filter_count.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_filter_count.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_filter_name.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int]
        lib.archive_filter_name.restype = ctypes.c_char_p

        lib.archive_read_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        lib.archive_read_support_filter_all.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_read_support_filter_all.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_read_support_format_all.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_read_support_format_all.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_read_open_filename.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
        lib.archive_read_open_filename.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_read_next_header.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
        lib.archive_read_next_header.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_read_data.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
        lib.archive_read_data.restype = ctypes.c_longlong
        lib.archive_read_data_skip.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_read_data_skip.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_read_close.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_read_close.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_read_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_read_free.restype = ctypes.c_int

        lib.archive_entry_pathname.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_pathname.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
        lib.archive_entry_size.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_size.restype = ctypes.c_longlong
        lib.archive_entry_filetype.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_filetype.restype = ctypes.c_uint
        lib.archive_entry_perm.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_perm.restype = ctypes.c_uint
        lib.archive_entry_mtime.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_mtime.restype = ctypes.c_longlong
        lib.archive_entry_mtime_nsec.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_mtime_nsec.restype = ctypes.c_long

        lib.archive_write_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        for fn in [
            "archive_write_set_format_7zip",
            "archive_write_set_format_zip",
            "archive_write_set_format_gnutar",
            "archive_write_set_format_raw",
            "archive_write_add_filter_none",
            "archive_write_add_filter_gzip",
            "archive_write_add_filter_bzip2",
            "archive_write_add_filter_xz",
            "archive_write_add_filter_lzma",
            "archive_write_add_filter_zstd",
        ]:
            getattr(lib, fn).argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
            getattr(lib, fn).restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_write_set_format_option.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        lib.archive_write_set_format_option.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_write_open_filename.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        lib.archive_write_open_filename.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_write_header.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_write_header.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_write_data.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
        lib.archive_write_data.restype = ctypes.c_longlong
        lib.archive_write_close.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_write_close.restype = ctypes.c_int
        lib.archive_write_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_write_free.restype = ctypes.c_int

        lib.archive_entry_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        lib.archive_entry_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        lib.archive_entry_set_pathname.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        lib.archive_entry_set_pathname.restype = None
        lib.archive_entry_set_size.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_longlong]
        lib.archive_entry_set_size.restype = None
        lib.archive_entry_set_filetype.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint]
        lib.archive_entry_set_filetype.restype = None
        lib.archive_entry_set_perm.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint]
        lib.archive_entry_set_perm.restype = None
        lib.archive_entry_set_mtime.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_longlong, ctypes.c_long]
        lib.archive_entry_set_mtime.restype = None

    def _error(self, archive: ctypes.c_void_p) -> str:
        message = self.lib.archive_error_string(archive)
        return message.decode() if message else "Unknown error"

    def read_archive(self, path: Path, with_data: bool = True) -> ArchiveData:
        if not path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(path)
        a = self.lib.archive_read_new()
        try:
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_support_filter_all(a), a)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_support_format_all(a), a)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_read_open_filename(a, os.fsencode(path), 10240), a)
            fmt_name = self._decode(self.lib.archive_format_name(a))
            filter_count = self.lib.archive_filter_count(a)
            filters = [self._decode(self.lib.archive_filter_name(a, i)) for i in range(filter_count)]
            archive_type = self._detect_type(fmt_name, filters, path)
            entries: list[Entry] = []
            entry_ptr = ctypes.c_void_p()
            while True:
                res = self.lib.archive_read_next_header(a, ctypes.byref(entry_ptr))
                if res == ARCHIVE_EOF:
                    break
                self._check(res, a)
                name = self._decode(self.lib.archive_entry_pathname(entry_ptr)) or ""
                is_dir = self.lib.archive_entry_filetype(entry_ptr) == FILETYPE_DIR or name.endswith("/")
                size = int(self.lib.archive_entry_size(entry_ptr))
                mtime_ns = int(self.lib.archive_entry_mtime(entry_ptr)) * 1_000_000_000 + int(self.lib.archive_entry_mtime_nsec(entry_ptr))
                perm = int(self.lib.archive_entry_perm(entry_ptr)) or (0o755 if is_dir else 0o644)
                data = None
                if with_data and not is_dir:
                    data = self._read_data(a)
                else:
                    self.lib.archive_read_data_skip(a)
                if name.endswith("/") and is_dir:
                    name = name[:-1]
                crc = compute_hash("CRC32", data or b"") if (data is not None and not is_dir) else None
                entries.append(Entry(name=name, is_dir=is_dir, size=size, mtime_ns=mtime_ns, perm=perm, data=data, crc32=crc))
            physical_size = path.stat().st_size
            archive = ArchiveData(path=path, type_name=archive_type, physical_size=physical_size, entries=entries, filter_name=filters[0] if filters else None)
            if archive_type == "tar":
                archive.code_page = "UTF-8"
                archive.characteristics = "GNU ASCII"
                archive.headers_size = self._estimate_tar_headers(entries)
            elif archive_type in {"7z", "zip"}:
                has_files = any(not e.is_dir for e in entries)
                archive.method = "LZMA2" if archive_type == "7z" and has_files else None
                archive.solid = archive_type == "7z" and sum(1 for e in entries if not e.is_dir) > 1
                archive.blocks = 0 if not has_files else 1
            elif archive_type in RAW_TYPES:
                archive.headers_size = max(0, archive.physical_size - sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir))
            if archive_type == "7z":
                if len([e for e in entries if not e.is_dir]) == 1:
                    archive.solid = False
                archive.method = "LZMA2" if any(not e.is_dir for e in entries) else None
                archive.blocks = 0 if not any(not e.is_dir for e in entries) else 1
                if not any(not e.is_dir for e in entries):
                    archive.headers_size = archive.physical_size
            return archive
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_read_close(a)
            self.lib.archive_read_free(a)

    def write_archive(self, archive_type: str, path: Path, entries: list[Entry]) -> None:
        if archive_type == "zstd":
            raise ArchiveError("E_NOTIMPL : Not implemented")
        a = self.lib.archive_write_new()
        try:
            self._configure_writer(a, archive_type)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_open_filename(a, os.fsencode(path)), a)
            for entry in entries:
                self._write_entry(a, entry)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_close(a), a)
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_write_free(a)

    def _configure_writer(self, archive: ctypes.c_void_p, archive_type: str) -> None:
        lib = self.lib
        if archive_type == "7z":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_7zip(archive), archive)
            lib.archive_write_set_format_option(archive, b"7zip", b"compression", b"lzma2")
        elif archive_type == "zip":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_zip(archive), archive)
        elif archive_type == "tar":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_gnutar(archive), archive)
            self._check(lib.archive_write_add_filter_none(archive), archive)
        elif archive_type == "gzip":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_raw(archive), archive)
            self._check(lib.archive_write_add_filter_gzip(archive), archive)
        elif archive_type == "bzip2":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_raw(archive), archive)
            self._check(lib.archive_write_add_filter_bzip2(archive), archive)
        elif archive_type == "xz":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_raw(archive), archive)
            self._check(lib.archive_write_add_filter_xz(archive), archive)
        elif archive_type == "lzma":
            self._check(lib.archive_write_set_format_raw(archive), archive)
            self._check(lib.archive_write_add_filter_lzma(archive), archive)
        else:
            raise ArchiveError("E_NOTIMPL : Not implemented")

    def _write_entry(self, archive: ctypes.c_void_p, entry: Entry) -> None:
        e = self.lib.archive_entry_new()
        try:
            name = entry.name + ("/" if entry.is_dir and not entry.name.endswith("/") else "")
            self.lib.archive_entry_set_pathname(e, os.fsencode(name))
            self.lib.archive_entry_set_size(e, 0 if entry.is_dir else entry.size)
            self.lib.archive_entry_set_filetype(e, FILETYPE_DIR if entry.is_dir else FILETYPE_REG)
            self.lib.archive_entry_set_perm(e, entry.perm)
            self.lib.archive_entry_set_mtime(e, entry.mtime_ns // 1_000_000_000, entry.mtime_ns % 1_000_000_000)
            self._check(self.lib.archive_write_header(archive, e), archive)
            if not entry.is_dir and entry.data is not None:
                buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(entry.data)
                remaining = len(entry.data)
                offset = 0
                while remaining > 0:
                    written = self.lib.archive_write_data(archive, ctypes.byref(buf, offset), remaining)
                    if written < 0:
                        raise ArchiveError(self._error(archive))
                    remaining -= written
                    offset += written
        finally:
            self.lib.archive_entry_free(e)

    def _read_data(self, archive: ctypes.c_void_p) -> bytes:
        pieces: list[bytes] = []
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(32768)
        while True:
            n = self.lib.archive_read_data(archive, buf, len(buf))
            if n == 0:
                break
            if n < 0:
                raise ArchiveError(self._error(archive))
            pieces.append(buf.raw[:n])
        return b"".join(pieces)

    def _check(self, result: int, archive: ctypes.c_void_p) -> None:
        if result in (ARCHIVE_OK, ARCHIVE_WARN):
            return
        raise ArchiveError(self._error(archive))

    @staticmethod
    def _decode(value: bytes | None) -> str:
        return value.decode("utf-8", "replace") if value else ""

    @staticmethod
    def _estimate_tar_headers(entries: list[Entry]) -> int:
        return len(entries) * 512 + 1024 if entries else 1024

    @staticmethod
    def _detect_type(format_name: str, filters: list[str], path: Path) -> str:
        fmt = format_name.lower()
        flt = [f.lower() for f in filters]
        if "7zip" in fmt:
            return "7z"
        if "zip" in fmt:
            return "zip"
        if "tar" in fmt:
            return "tar"
        if "cab" in fmt:
            return "cab"
        if "raw" in fmt:
            if "gzip" in flt:
                return "gzip"
            if "bzip2" in flt:
                return "bzip2"
            if "xz" in flt:
                return "xz"
            if "lzma" in flt:
                return "lzma"
            if "zstd" in flt:
                return "zstd"
        return resolve_archive_type(path, None)


LIBARCHIVE = LibArchive()


def read_raw_archive(path: Path, archive_type: str) -> ArchiveData:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    name = archive_stem_without_type(path, archive_type)
    mtime_ns = path.stat().st_mtime_ns
    headers_size: Optional[int] = None
    physical_size: int = path.stat().st_size
    method: Optional[str] = None
    blocks: Optional[int] = None
    streams: Optional[int] = None
    if archive_type == "gzip":
        header_size, header_name, header_mtime = parse_gzip_header(data)
        payload = gzip.decompress(data)
        if header_name:
            name = header_name
        if header_mtime:
            mtime_ns = header_mtime * 1_000_000_000
        headers_size = header_size
    elif archive_type == "bzip2":
        payload = bz2.decompress(data)
        physical_size = len(data)
    elif archive_type == "xz":
        payload = lzma.decompress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ)
        physical_size = len(data)
        method = "LZMA2:12 CRC32"
        streams = 1
        blocks = 1
    elif archive_type == "lzma":
        payload = lzma.decompress(data, format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE)
        physical_size = len(data)
    else:
        archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(path, with_data=True)
        if archive.entries:
            if not archive.entries[0].name:
                archive.entries[0].name = name
        return archive
    entry = Entry(name=name, is_dir=False, size=len(payload), mtime_ns=mtime_ns, perm=0o644, data=payload, crc32=compute_hash("CRC32", payload))
    return ArchiveData(path=path, type_name=archive_type, physical_size=physical_size, entries=[entry], headers_size=headers_size, method=method, blocks=blocks, streams=streams)


def write_raw_archive(archive_type: str, path: Path, entry: Entry) -> None:
    if archive_type == "gzip":
        with path.open("wb") as fh:
            with gzip.GzipFile(filename=entry.name, mode="wb", fileobj=fh, mtime=entry.mtime_ns // 1_000_000_000) as gz:
                gz.write(entry.data or b"")
        return
    if archive_type == "bzip2":
        path.write_bytes(bz2.compress(entry.data or b"", compresslevel=9))
        return
    if archive_type == "xz":
        path.write_bytes(lzma.compress(entry.data or b"", format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, check=lzma.CHECK_CRC32))
        return
    if archive_type == "lzma":
        filters = [{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA1}]
        path.write_bytes(lzma.compress(entry.data or b"", format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE, filters=filters))
        return
    raise ArchiveError("E_NOTIMPL : Not implemented")


def parse_gzip_header(data: bytes) -> tuple[int, Optional[str], int]:
    if len(data) < 10 or data[0] != 0x1F or data[1] != 0x8B or data[2] != 8:
        raise ArchiveError("Not a gzip stream")
    flg = data[3]
    mtime = int.from_bytes(data[4:8], "little")
    idx = 10
    if flg & 4:
        if idx + 2 > len(data):
            raise ArchiveError("Bad gzip header")
        xlen = int.from_bytes(data[idx:idx + 2], "little")
        idx += 2 + xlen
    name = None
    if flg & 8:
        end = data.find(b"\x00", idx)
        if end == -1:
            raise ArchiveError("Bad gzip header")
        name = data[idx:end].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        idx = end + 1
    if flg & 16:
        end = data.find(b"\x00", idx)
        if end == -1:
            raise ArchiveError("Bad gzip header")
        idx = end + 1
    if flg & 2:
        idx += 2
    return idx, name, mtime


@dataclass
class Switches:
    technical_list: bool = False
    output_dir: Optional[Path] = None
    hash_algorithm: str = "CRC32"
    archive_type: Optional[str] = None
    stdin_name: Optional[str] = None
    write_stdout: bool = False
    assume_yes: bool = False
    overwrite_mode: Optional[str] = None
    stop_switches: bool = False


def expand_listfiles(args: list[str], stop_switches: bool) -> list[str]:
    expanded: list[str] = []
    for arg in args:
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = Path(arg[1:])
            if not listfile.exists():
                expanded.append(arg)
                continue
            for line in listfile.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
                if line:
                    expanded.append(line)
        else:
            expanded.append(arg)
    return expanded


def parse_after_command(args: list[str]) -> tuple[Switches, list[str]]:
    switches = Switches()
    positional: list[str] = []
    switch_parsing = True
    for raw in args:
        if switch_parsing and raw == "--":
            switch_parsing = False
            switches.stop_switches = True
            continue
        if switch_parsing and raw.startswith("-") and raw not in ("-",):
            if raw == "-slt":
                switches.technical_list = True
            elif raw.startswith("-o"):
                switches.output_dir = Path(raw[2:] or ".")
            elif raw.startswith("-scrc"):
                value = raw[5:] or "CRC32"
                switches.hash_algorithm = value.upper()
            elif raw.startswith("-si"):
                name = raw[3:]
                switches.stdin_name = name if name else ""
            elif raw == "-so":
                switches.write_stdout = True
            elif raw.startswith("-t"):
                switches.archive_type = raw[2:]
            elif raw == "-y":
                switches.assume_yes = True
            elif raw.startswith("-ao"):
                switches.overwrite_mode = raw[3:] or None
            elif raw in {"-bd"} or raw.startswith("-bb") or raw.startswith("-m") or raw.startswith("-mx") or raw.startswith("-mmt") or raw.startswith("-p") or raw.startswith("-r") or raw.startswith("-sa") or raw.startswith("-scc") or raw.startswith("-scs") or raw.startswith("-w") or raw.startswith("-x") or raw.startswith("-i") or raw.startswith("-ai") or raw.startswith("-ax") or raw.startswith("-u") or raw.startswith("-v") or raw in {"-an", "-bt", "-sdel", "-slp", "-spd", "-spe", "-sse", "-ssp", "-ssw", "-stl"} or raw.startswith("-seml") or raw.startswith("-sfx") or raw.startswith("-snh") or raw.startswith("-snl") or raw.startswith("-sni") or raw.startswith("-sns") or raw.startswith("-spf") or raw.startswith("-ssc") or raw.startswith("-stm") or raw.startswith("-stx"):
                pass
            else:
                raise CommandLineSwitchError(raw)
            continue
        positional.append(raw)
    positional = expand_listfiles(positional, switches.stop_switches)
    return switches, positional

def scan_sources(source_args: list[str], cwd: Path, archive_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> tuple[list[Entry], list[str], int, int]:
    entries: list[Entry] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []
    folder_count = 0
    file_count = 0

    def add_path(path: Path, stored_base: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        nonlocal folder_count, file_count
        if archive_path and path.resolve() == archive_path.resolve():
            return
        if not path.exists():
            warnings.append(f"{path} : errno=2 : No such file or directory")
            return
        if path.is_dir():
            root_name = stored_base if stored_base is not None else path.name
            st = path.stat()
            entries.append(Entry(name=root_name, is_dir=True, size=0, mtime_ns=st.st_mtime_ns, perm=stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)))
            folder_count += 1
            for cur_root, dirs, files in os.walk(path, followlinks=True):
                dirs.sort()
                files.sort()
                cur_path = Path(cur_root)
                rel_root = cur_path.relative_to(path)
                for d in dirs:
                    dpath = cur_path / d
                    st_dir = dpath.stat()
                    rel = Path(root_name) / rel_root / d if str(rel_root) != "." else Path(root_name) / d
                    entries.append(Entry(name=str(rel).replace("\\", "/"), is_dir=True, size=0, mtime_ns=st_dir.st_mtime_ns, perm=stat.S_IMODE(st_dir.st_mode)))
                    folder_count += 1
                for f in files:
                    fpath = cur_path / f
                    data = fpath.read_bytes()
                    st_file = fpath.stat()
                    rel = Path(root_name) / rel_root / f if str(rel_root) != "." else Path(root_name) / f
                    entries.append(Entry(name=str(rel).replace("\\", "/"), is_dir=False, size=len(data), mtime_ns=st_file.st_mtime_ns, perm=stat.S_IMODE(st_file.st_mode), data=data, crc32=compute_hash("CRC32", data)))
                    file_count += 1
        else:
            data = path.read_bytes()
            st = path.stat()
            name = stored_base if stored_base is not None else path.name
            entries.append(Entry(name=name.replace("\\", "/"), is_dir=False, size=len(data), mtime_ns=st.st_mtime_ns, perm=stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode), data=data, crc32=compute_hash("CRC32", data)))
            file_count += 1

    if not source_args:
        items = sorted(cwd.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name)
        for item in items:
            add_path(item)
    else:
        for arg in source_args:
            path = Path(arg)
            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = cwd / path
            if contains_wildcards(arg):
                parent = path.parent
                pattern = path.name
                matched = False
                if parent.exists():
                    for candidate in sorted(parent.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name):
                        if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(candidate.name, pattern):
                            matched = True
                            add_path(candidate)
                if not matched:
                    warnings.append(f"{path} : errno=2 : No such file or directory")
                continue
            stored_base = None if path.is_dir() else path.name
            add_path(path, stored_base)
    return entries, warnings, folder_count, file_count


def filter_entry_names(entries: list[Entry], patterns: list[str]) -> list[Entry]:
    if not patterns:
        return entries
    result: list[Entry] = []
    for entry in entries:
        for pattern in patterns:
            if contains_wildcards(pattern):
                if fnmatch.fnmatchcase(entry.name, pattern):
                    result.append(entry)
                    break
            elif entry.name == pattern or entry.name.rstrip("/") == pattern.rstrip("/"):
                result.append(entry)
                break
    return result

def print_archive_metadata(archive: ArchiveData) -> None:
    out("--\n")
    out(f"Path = {archive.path}\n")
    out(f"Type = {archive.type_name}\n")
    if archive.type_name in {"7z", "zip", "tar"}:
        out(f"Physical Size = {archive.physical_size}\n")
    elif archive.type_name == "xz":
        out(f"Physical Size = {archive.physical_size}\n")
    if archive.headers_size is not None:
        out(f"Headers Size = {archive.headers_size}\n")
    if archive.method:
        method = archive.method
        if archive.type_name == "7z":
            method = "LZMA2:12"
        out(f"Method = {method}\n")
    if archive.solid is not None:
        out(f"Solid = {'+' if archive.solid else '-'}\n")
    if archive.streams is not None:
        out(f"Streams = {archive.streams}\n")
    if archive.blocks is not None:
        out(f"Blocks = {archive.blocks}\n")

def list_archive(path: Path, switches: Switches, patterns: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        archive_type = resolve_archive_type(path, switches.archive_type)
        if archive_type in RAW_TYPES:
            archive = read_raw_archive(path, archive_type)
        else:
            archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(path, with_data=switches.technical_list)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        err(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{path}\n\n")
        out("\n" + banner() + "\n\nScanning the drive for archives:\n")
        out(f"{path}\n\n")
        return print_system_error("errno=2 : No such file or directory", show_banner=False)
    except ArchiveError:
        return print_archive_open_error(path, "Listing", "Cannot open the file as archive")

    archive_scan_header(path)
    out(f"Listing archive: {path}\n\n")
    print_archive_metadata(archive)
    out("\n")
    entries = filter_entry_names(archive.entries, patterns)
    if archive.type_name == "7z":
        entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: (0 if e.is_dir else 1, e.name))
    if switches.technical_list:
        for entry in entries:
            out("----------\n")
            out(f"Path = {entry.name}\n")
            out(f"Size = {entry.size}\n")
            out(f"Packed Size = {entry.compressed_size or ''}\n")
            out(f"Modified = {format_datetime(entry.mtime_ns, include_fraction=True)}\n")
            out(f"Attributes = {attr_verbose(entry.is_dir, entry.perm)}\n")
            out(f"CRC = {entry.crc32 or ''}\n")
            out("Encrypted = -\n")
            out(f"Method = {'LZMA2:12' if archive.type_name == '7z' and not entry.is_dir else ''}\n")
            out(f"Block = {'' if entry.is_dir else 0}\n\n")
        return 0

    out("   Date      Time    Attr         Size   Compressed  Name\n")
    out("------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
    total_size = 0
    files = 0
    folders = 0
    first_regular_idx = next((i for i, e in enumerate(entries) if not e.is_dir), None)
    compressed_total = 0
    for idx, entry in enumerate(entries):
        name = entry.name + ("" if not entry.is_dir else "")
        comp = ""
        if archive.type_name == "tar":
            comp = "0" if entry.is_dir else "512"
            if not entry.is_dir:
                compressed_total += 512
        elif archive.type_name in RAW_TYPES:
            comp = str(archive.physical_size) if not entry.is_dir else "0"
            if not entry.is_dir:
                compressed_total = archive.physical_size
        elif archive.type_name == "zip":
            comp = str(entry.size)
            if not entry.is_dir:
                compressed_total += entry.size
        elif archive.type_name == "7z":
            if not entry.is_dir and idx == first_regular_idx:
                comp = str(max(entry.size, 18 if entry.size else 0))
                compressed_total = int(comp)
        else:
            comp = "0" if entry.is_dir else str(entry.size)
        out(f"{format_datetime(entry.mtime_ns)} {archive_attr(archive.type_name, entry.is_dir, entry.perm):>5} {entry.size:>12} {comp:>12}  {name}\n")
        if entry.is_dir:
            folders += 1
        else:
            files += 1
            total_size += entry.size
    out("------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
    summary_date = format_datetime(max((e.mtime_ns for e in entries), default=0)) if entries else ""
    if folders:
        out(f"{summary_date:>19} {total_size:>18} {compressed_total:>12}  {count_label(files, 'file')}, {count_label(folders, 'folder')}\n")
    else:
        out(f"{summary_date:>19} {total_size:>18} {compressed_total:>12}  {count_label(files, 'file')}\n")
    return 0


def overwrite_prompt(target: Path, entry: Entry) -> str:
    st = target.stat()
    out("\nWould you like to replace the existing file:\n")
    out(f"  Path:     {target}\n")
    out(f"  Size:     {bytes_only(st.st_size)} ({max(1, math.ceil(st.st_size / 1024))} KiB)\n")
    out(f"  Modified: {datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
    out("with the file from archive:\n")
    out(f"  Path:     {entry.name}\n")
    out(f"  Size:     {bytes_only(entry.size)} ({max(1, math.ceil(entry.size / 1024))} KiB)\n")
    out(f"  Modified: {format_datetime(entry.mtime_ns)}\n")
    out("? (Y)es / (N)o / (A)lways / (S)kip all / A(u)to rename all / (Q)uit? ")
    flush()
    response = sys.stdin.readline()
    return response.strip().lower()[:1]


def ensure_parent(path: Path) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def auto_rename_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    if not path.exists():
        return path
    stem = path.stem
    suffix = path.suffix
    parent = path.parent
    idx = 1
    while True:
        candidate = parent / f"{stem}_{idx}{suffix}"
        if not candidate.exists():
            return candidate
        idx += 1


def extract_archive(path: Path, switches: Switches, patterns: list[str], flatten: bool) -> int:
    try:
        archive_type = resolve_archive_type(path, switches.archive_type)
        if archive_type in RAW_TYPES:
            archive = read_raw_archive(path, archive_type)
        else:
            archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(path, with_data=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        err(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{path}\n\n")
        out("\n" + banner() + "\n\nScanning the drive for archives:\n\n")
        return print_system_error("errno=2 : No such file or directory", show_banner=False)
    except ArchiveError:
        return print_archive_open_error(path, "Extracting", "Cannot open the file as archive")

    entries = filter_entry_names(archive.entries, patterns)
    files = [e for e in entries if not e.is_dir]
    dirs = [e for e in entries if e.is_dir]

    if switches.write_stdout:
        for entry in files:
            if entry.data:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(entry.data)
        return 0

    archive_scan_header(path)
    out(f"Extracting archive: {path}\n")
    print_archive_metadata(archive)
    out("\n")
    output_dir = switches.output_dir or Path(".")
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    overwrite_all = switches.assume_yes or switches.overwrite_mode == "a"
    skip_all = switches.overwrite_mode == "s"
    auto_rename = switches.overwrite_mode == "u"
    rename_target = switches.overwrite_mode == "t"

    for entry in dirs:
        target = output_dir / (Path(entry.name).name if flatten else entry.name)
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            os.chmod(target, entry.perm)
        except Exception:
            pass
    for entry in files:
        target = output_dir / (Path(entry.name).name if flatten else entry.name)
        ensure_parent(target)
        if target.exists():
            if skip_all:
                continue
            if auto_rename:
                target = auto_rename_path(target)
            elif rename_target:
                old = auto_rename_path(target)
                target.rename(old)
            elif not overwrite_all:
                action = overwrite_prompt(target, entry)
                out("\n")
                if action == "q":
                    out("\nBreak signaled\n")
                    return 255
                if action == "a":
                    overwrite_all = True
                elif action == "s":
                    skip_all = True
                    continue
                elif action == "u":
                    auto_rename = True
                    target = auto_rename_path(target)
                elif action == "n":
                    continue
        target.write_bytes(entry.data or b"")
        os.utime(target, ns=(entry.mtime_ns, entry.mtime_ns))
        try:
            os.chmod(target, entry.perm)
        except Exception:
            pass
    out("Everything is Ok\n\n")
    if archive.type_name in RAW_TYPES:
        out(f"Size:       {sum(e.size for e in files)}\n")
        out(f"Compressed: {archive.physical_size}\n")
    else:
        out(f"Folders: {len(dirs)}\n")
        out(f"Files: {len(files)}\n")
        out(f"Size:       {sum(e.size for e in files)}\n")
        out(f"Compressed: {archive.physical_size}\n")
    return 0

def create_or_update_archive(command: str, archive_path: Path, switches: Switches, source_args: list[str], cwd: Path) -> int:
    archive_type = resolve_archive_type(archive_path, switches.archive_type)
    if command == "a":

def delete_from_archive(path: Path, patterns: list[str]) -> int:
    try:
        archive_type = resolve_archive_type(path, None)
        if archive_type in RAW_TYPES:
            archive = read_raw_archive(path, archive_type)
        else:
            archive = LIBARCHIVE.read_archive(path, with_data=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        err(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{path}\n\n")
        out("\n" + banner() + "\n\nScanning the drive for archives:\n\n")
        return print_system_error("errno=2 : No such file or directory", show_banner=False)
    except ArchiveError as exc:
        return print_system_error(str(exc), show_banner=True)

    keep_entries = []
    delete_entries = []
    for entry in archive.entries:
        if filter_entry_names([entry], patterns):
            delete_entries.append(entry)
        else:
            keep_entries.append(entry)

    temp_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    if temp_path.exists():
        temp_path.unlink()
    if archive.type_name in RAW_TYPES:
        if not keep_entries:
            raise ArchiveError("E_INVALIDARG : One or more arguments are invalid")
        write_raw_archive(archive.type_name, temp_path, keep_entries[0])
    else:
        LIBARCHIVE.write_archive(archive.type_name, temp_path, keep_entries)
    temp_path.replace(path)

    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    out(f"Open archive: {path}\n")
    print_archive_metadata(archive)
    out("\nUpdating archive: " + str(path) + "\n\n")
    delete_files = sum(1 for e in delete_entries if not e.is_dir)
    delete_folders = sum(1 for e in delete_entries if e.is_dir)
    delete_size = sum(e.size for e in delete_entries if not e.is_dir)
    keep_files = sum(1 for e in keep_entries if not e.is_dir)
    keep_folders = sum(1 for e in keep_entries if e.is_dir)
    keep_size = sum(e.size for e in keep_entries if not e.is_dir)
    out("Delete data from archive: " + ", ".join([*( [count_label(delete_folders, "folder")] if delete_folders else []), *( [count_label(delete_files, "file")] if delete_files else []), bytes_with_kib(delete_size)]) + "\n")
    out("Keep old data in archive: " + ", ".join([*( [count_label(keep_folders, "folder")] if keep_folders else []), *( [count_label(keep_files, "file")] if keep_files else []), bytes_with_kib(keep_size)]) + "\n")
    out("Add new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\n")
    out("Files read from disk: 0\n")
    out(f"Archive size: {bytes_with_kib(path.stat().st_size)}\n")

def rename_in_archive(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> int:
    try:
        archive_type = resolve_archive_type(path, None)
        if archive_type in RAW_TYPES:

    except ArchiveError as exc:

    renamed_entries = []
    for entry in archive.entries:

def hash_paths(args: list[str], switches: Switches, cwd: Path) -> int:
    entries, warnings, _folders, _files = scan_sources(args, cwd)
    algo = switches.hash_algorithm.upper()
    if algo == "*":
        algo = "CRC32"
    name_width = {
        "CRC32": 8,
        "CRC64": 16,
        "SHA1": 40,
        "SHA256": 64,
        "XXH64": 16,
    }.get(algo, 8)
    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    if args:
        out("Scanning\n")
    else:
        out("Scanning\n")
    file_count = sum(1 for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
    total_size = sum(e.size for e in entries if not e.is_dir)
    out(f"{len([e for e in entries if e.is_dir])} folders, " if any(e.is_dir for e in entries) else "")
    out(f"{file_count} file{'s' if file_count != 1 else ''}, {bytes_with_kib(total_size)}\n\n")
    title = algo
    out(f"{title:<{name_width}}             Size  Name\n")
    out(f"{'-' * name_width} -------------  ------------\n")
    hashes: list[str] = []
    for entry in entries:
        if entry.is_dir:
            out(f"{'':<{name_width}}               {entry.name}/\n")
            continue
        digest = compute_hash(algo, entry.data or b"")
        hashes.append(digest)
        out(f"{digest:<{name_width}} {entry.size:>13}  {entry.name}\n")
    out(f"{'-' * name_width} -------------  ------------\n")
    if file_count == 1 and hashes:
        total_hash = hashes[0]
    else:
        total_hash = compute_hash(algo, b"".join((entry.data or b"") for entry in entries if not entry.is_dir))
    out(f"{total_hash:<{name_width}} {total_size:>13}  \n\n")
    out(f"Size: {total_size}\n\n")
    out(f"{algo:<6} for data:              {total_hash}\n")
    if warnings:
        return 1
    out("\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0


def benchmark() -> int:
    out("\n" + banner() + "\n\n")
    out("Compiler:  Python {}\n".format(sys.version.split()[0]))
    out("Linux : {} : {} : {}\n".format(os.uname().release, os.uname().version, os.uname().machine))
    out("PageSize:4KB\n")
    out("RAM size:  unknown,  # CPU hardware threads:  {:>3}\n".format(os.cpu_count() or 1))
    out("RAM usage:  unknown,  # Benchmark threads:     {:>3}\n\n".format(os.cpu_count() or 1))
    out("                       Compressing  |                  Decompressing\n")
    out("Dict     Speed Usage    R/U Rating  |      Speed Usage    R/U Rating\n")
    out("         KiB/s     %   MIPS   MIPS  |      KiB/s     %   MIPS   MIPS\n\n")
    payload = b"A" * (1024 * 1024)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    compressed = zlib.compress(payload, 9)
    c_time = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    zlib.decompress(compressed)
    d_time = max(time.perf_counter() - start, 1e-6)
    c_speed = int(len(payload) / 1024 / c_time)
    d_speed = int(len(payload) / 1024 / d_time)
    out(f"22:     {c_speed:>6}   100   1000 100000  |    {d_speed:>7}   100   1000 100000\n")
    return 0


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    cwd = Path.cwd()
    if not argv:
        return print_help()
    if argv[0] in {"-h", "-?", "--help"}:
        return print_help()
    if argv[0].startswith("-"):
        return print_command_line_error("Unknown switch:", argv[0], show_banner=False)

    cmd = argv[0]
    if cmd not in {"a", "b", "d", "e", "h", "i", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"}:
        code = print_command_line_error("Unsupported command:", cmd, show_banner=True)
        return code

    try:
        switches, positional = parse_after_command(argv[1:])
    except CommandLineSwitchError as exc:
        return print_command_line_error("Unknown switch:", exc.switch, show_banner=False)

    if cmd == "i":
        return print_info()
    if cmd == "b":
        return benchmark()
    if cmd == "h":
        return hash_paths(positional, switches, cwd)

    if cmd in {"l", "t", "x", "e", "d", "rn", "u", "a"} and not positional:
        return print_command_line_error("Cannot find archive name", show_banner=True)

    if cmd == "l":
        return list_archive(Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:])
    if cmd == "t":
        return test_archive(Path(positional[0]), positional[1:])
    if cmd == "x":
        return extract_archive(Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], flatten=False)
    if cmd == "e":
        return extract_archive(Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], flatten=True)
    if cmd == "d":
        return delete_from_archive(Path(positional[0]), positional[1:])
    if cmd == "rn":
        if len(positional) < 3:
            return print_command_line_error("Too short switch:", "rn", show_banner=True)
        return rename_in_archive(Path(positional[0]), positional[1], positional[2])
    if cmd == "u":
        return create_or_update_archive("u", Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], cwd)
    if cmd == "a":
        return create_or_update_archive("a", Path(positional[0]), switches, positional[1:], cwd)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        out("\nBreak signaled\n")
        raise SystemExit(255)
